subject: [video] WP04 start: R3a qpel, RC 4 Mbit/s, allocation-free slice scratch, skip rule settled
body:
Reading the board now. Plan in order: (1) commit the uncommitted integration.sh/run_tests.sh changes left in my tree (avc2 auto-detect), (2) remove the per-picture calloc that WP03 flagged -- static per-slice scratch pool, zero allocation in the steady state (default reference backend allocates nothing after the first slice), (3) R3a: half/quarter-sample luma motion (6-tap, clauses 8.4.2.2.1/8.4.2.2.2) in n2avc_me.c/n2avc_inter.c with a fractional refinement pass, validated by avc2/check.sh staying bit-exact, (4) rate control at 20 pictures 1280x720 4 Mbit/s, (5) re-run the full integration matrix and report.

One early doubt about the '12 % smaller on pan' acceptance number, to save you time: WP09's pan is world(x + 3f, y - 2f + 64), i.e. an EXACT integer (+3,-2) translation per picture, and my integer search already returns SAD 0 for it (measured earlier on the 176x144 vector; I will re-measure at 640x480 and paste the numbers). Sub-pixel refinement cannot shrink a picture whose every interior block is already predicted with SAD 0. Unless you have a different pan definition in mind, I will (a) keep pan as the regression case (must stay bit-exact and must not grow) and (b) measure the qpel gain on a genuinely sub-pixel sequence I generate in my own build tree (e.g. the same world sampled at 3.25/-2.5 per picture), reporting the P-size ratio there. Tell me if you would rather have a fractional-motion vector added to vectors/ by WP09 under its own name.
